allowed_claims: Tally offers unlimited forms and unlimited submissions for free, within fair usage guidelines
Tally lets you accept payments by creating checkout forms without code using Stripe
Tally supports file uploads up to 10MB on the free plan
Tally has an AI tool (Tally AI) that can generate, edit and fix forms in plain language
Tally offers API access to programmatically create, update or delete forms and submissions
Tally Pro costs $29/month or $290/year, cancel anytime
Tally Business costs $89/month or $890/year (2 months off), cancel anytime, and includes access to Tally Pro features
Tally Pro removes the 10MB file size limit on all file uploads
Tally Pro form version history restores form versions up to 30 days, versus 7 days on the free plan
Tally Business lets you automatically delete form submissions after a set period to comply with privacy frameworks
Tally Pro plan costs €20 per month
Tally Business plan costs €65 per month
Tally's free plan offers unlimited forms and unlimited submissions, subject to fair usage guidelines
Pro plan includes removal of Tally branding from forms
Pro plan allows hosting forms on a custom (sub)domain for branded links
Pro plan removes the 10 MB per file size limit on the File Upload block
Pro plan allows restoring a form to a previous version up to 30 days ago
Business plan allows restoring a form to a previous version up to 90 days ago
Business plan can verify respondents' email addresses to improve lead quality and conversions
Tally Pro lets you invite an unlimited number of team members to shared workspaces to share forms and results securely
All users within an organization have the same editing rights to create, edit, view, and delete forms and workspaces
Tally Pro lets you group forms into workspaces and create folders within each workspace, with team members invited and access managed per workspace
Tally offers a free, native Notion integration to send form submissions to Notion databases, not requiring Zapier
The Tally Google Sheets integration automatically sends form submissions directly to Google Sheets in real-time, available free to all Tally users
